opening.argument: The presentation leads with a paid entry requirement: viewers are told to pay a $99 one-off membership fee and then buy shares in one of four mining pools. It presents those shares as funding a Bitcoin mining machine, with profit shares credited to a wallet for withdrawal, while directing viewers to join through a link. It reinforces the offer by calling the company legitimate, transparent, and verified, and by promoting referral income. Although earnings are said to depend on daily mining performance and recruitment is described as optional, those qualifications do not displace the central pitch: pay to participate in a mining-pool scheme for purported recurring profits.
